scope: Current Rig Studio subjects; recommendations are anatomical assessments, not completed imports.
verification: Catalog links verified from the site. Playback/controls inspected for WoW Lion, TFT13 Elise spider, Murk Wolf Mini, Grumpy Lion and Batnivia. Other export/clip sets are not yet tested. Captain Lancy Revshon inspected and transferred through its external skeleton.

wow.status: Exact lion transferred directly from M2: display 39134, model 124781, 69 source bones, 49 entries / 38 distinct sequences, 37 native joints. New Dreadmane Lion enemy; original lions unchanged.
workflow: Resolve NPC 55491 to display 39134 and model 124781 using public viewer metadata.
Read MD21/MD20 v272 skeletal tracks and the eight AFID external animation files.
Convert into 37 native Wildbound joints, keeping 49 source entries with alias provenance.
Assemble editable pixel body, mane, skull, eyes, ears, muzzle, nose and jaw.
Register dreadmane_lion and The Dreadmane wakes encounter with claw combo, roar and telegraphed pounce.

currentRigs.subject: Oathless Captain
currentRigs.notes: Exact display 36758, human female model 1000764 and external skeleton 2137789. 34 native joints and 31 selected actions. Separate enemy with sword/thrust, shield bash and a charge; existing player rig unchanged.

currentRigs.subject: Dreadmane Lion
currentRigs.notes: Separate enemy from exact NPC 55491. 37 native joints; 49 animation entries, 38 distinct sequences. Two-hit claws, area roar, pounce and sleep/wake. Original lion and white lion remain separate.

currentRigs.subject: Wolves / scavenger pack
currentRigs.notes: Mini already transferred in the separate Murk test. Naafiri is an alternative canine; its extra blades would be omitted from native art.

currentRigs.subject: Lion / white lion
currentRigs.notes: WoW is the strongest natural lion reference. Cougar is a useful LoL alternative. Grumpy Lion is a round, stylized pet, not a natural lion gait. Rengar is upright and a poor quadruped donor.

currentRigs.subject: Other large cats
currentRigs.notes: Use cougar form. Different body proportions still need a bone mapping and stride/foot-contact check.

currentRigs.subject: Spider / tarantula
currentRigs.notes: TFT 13 viewer tested: Run, Attack1, Attack2, Crit, Death, Idle1, KnockUp, Celebration, heal and jump. Confirm each leg chain against our eight-leg rig before transfer.

currentRigs.subject: Crouching predator
currentRigs.notes: Choose canine or feline movement first; the current creature is an invented predator.

currentRigs.subject: Boar
currentRigs.notes: Bristle is a useful boar reference, but the rider and mount are one character setup. Isolating mount bones is extra work.

currentRigs.subject: Six-legged scarab
currentRigs.notes: Scorpion/crab/grub alternatives. None is a verified six-legged scarab drop-in; confirm limb count and gait.

currentRigs.subject: Crocodile / alligator
currentRigs.notes: Renekton walks upright. The lizard is a small map prop with an unverified clip set. No suitable natural crocodile donor confirmed here.

currentRigs.subject: Elephant
currentRigs.notes: No convincing trunked quadruped candidate found in the inspected site catalog.

currentRigs.subject: Rhino
currentRigs.notes: No convincing natural rhinoceros candidate found in the inspected catalog.

currentRigs.subject: Zebra
currentRigs.notes: Centaur bodies provide four-leg reference only; their humanoid torsos change the balance and stride. No natural zebra/horse rig confirmed here.

currentRigs.subject: Pelican
currentRigs.notes: Bird body or flight reference. No pelican beak/pouch skeleton confirmed; map-prop animation sets need checking.

currentRigs.subject: Bat
currentRigs.notes: Dedicated Bat_Mat model loads and animates in the viewer. Full wing mapping and export remain unchecked.

currentRigs.subject: Tsetse fly
currentRigs.notes: Flyguy is a catalog lead, not a validated fly. Kha’Zix is an insect monster, not a fly gait.

currentRigs.subject: Winged dragon
currentRigs.notes: Compare wing and leg topology before choosing. Some dragon forms have different supporting limbs.

currentRigs.subject: Segmented snake
currentRigs.notes: Cassiopeia is a snake-bodied humanoid; Baron is a large rooted serpent. Neither is a verified ordinary ground snake.

currentRigs.subject: Monkey
currentRigs.notes: Wukong is an upright staff fighter. Useful for a humanoid monkey NPC, less suitable for natural quadruped motion.

currentRigs.subject: Stone golem
currentRigs.notes: Blue Sentinel for heavy biped movement; Krug for a squat rock creature.

currentRigs.subject: Fire elemental
currentRigs.notes: Good humanoid casting/body reference. Flame effects need native Wildbound art and effects.

currentRigs.subject: Water elemental
currentRigs.notes: Zac offers fluid body motion; Nami offers aquatic/serpentine movement. Neither is a matching water-elemental skeleton.

currentRigs.subject: Carnivorous flower / snapping plant
currentRigs.notes: Dedicated rooted attack plants; inspect jaw and stem chains before transfer.

currentRigs.subject: Grasping vine
currentRigs.notes: Rooted plant/tendril reference. Not yet confirmed to provide a long wrapping chain like our rig.

currentRigs.subject: Poison / spore pod
currentRigs.notes: Useful plant/pod silhouette and possible hit/pop reference; not a verified walking or breathing creature rig.

currentRigs.subject: Burrowing monster
currentRigs.notes: Rek’Sai is the closest burrower behavior. Different limb and segment layout requires adaptation.

currentRigs.subject: Mechanical trap
currentRigs.notes: No direct match verified for our trap mechanism. Native authored opening/closing keys are likely simpler.

currentRigs.subject: Humanoid base
currentRigs.notes: Lee Sin for unarmed motion, Garen for sword combat, Leona for sword and shield. Weapon-specific clips need matching Wildbound hand grips.

currentRigs.subject: Rifle hunter
currentRigs.notes: Two-handed firearm stance; gun proportions and grip spacing require remapping.

currentRigs.subject: Zombie
currentRigs.notes: Zombie Brand for humanoid shambling; Sion for a heavy brute; ghoul for a hunched creature.

currentRigs.subject: Sword skeleton / boss
currentRigs.notes: Use sword/brute/undead motion on our skeleton art. These are not plain skeleton meshes.

currentRigs.subject: Archer / Banshee Queen
currentRigs.notes: Both Wildbound subjects use equipped humanoid/archery motion. For a floating spirit variant, Thresh or Karthus is a separate design choice.

currentRigs.subject: Unarmed skeleton
currentRigs.notes: Use the unarmed human skeleton motion; retain our own skeletal pixel parts.

currentRigs.subject: Skeletal mage / necromancer
currentRigs.notes: Karthus for undead staff casting; Ryze for humanoid casting. Frost styling stays in Wildbound art.

currentRigs.subject: Winged humanoid
currentRigs.notes: Morgana has a winged humanoid form. Evelynn supplies demonic humanoid motion but not equivalent wings.

currentRigs.subject: Small winged demon
currentRigs.notes: Useful small demon character reference; cannon/body animations are not verified flying-imp motion.

currentRigs.subject: Krampus / horned humanoid
currentRigs.notes: Trundle for a lumbering club-wielding creature; Ornn for a heavy horned character. No exact Krampus donor confirmed.
